# Notices and provenance

This project is a modern Fortran translation of the computational core of:

- `rumidas` 0.1.3, copyright Vincenzo Candila and contributors, GPL-3.

The unmodified upstream package snapshot supplied for the translation is
retained under `original/rumidas-master`.

The project uses the attached modern Fortran translation of `maxLik` 1.5.2 as a
